notes: This manifest describes generated fixture inputs, not product captures or approved visual targets.
External assets are not bundled in this repository. Record source, license, version, retrieval date, and SHA-256 before using them.
Alpha is stored as straight or premultiplied explicitly. Never infer alpha association from file extension alone.
Depth maps are normalized only for visualization. Raw values and units must be recorded for each fixture.

fixtures.expected_use: alpha boundary and basic variable-width line evaluation

fixtures.alpha_note: alpha is fully opaque so only depth discontinuity contributes to the line
fixtures.truth: truth-depth.npy (rectangle geometry, not the rendered depth field)
fixtures.expected_use: depth discontinuity evaluation; normal and color edges are deferred

color_contract.storage: float32 linear RGBA for reference model
color_contract.display: composite over black, gray, and white backgrounds in linear light, then convert to sRGB only for review images
color_contract.known_limitation: Artifact runtime color descriptors and alpha conventions are not verified by this manifest

depth_contract.storage: float32 depth in a documented arbitrary unit
depth_contract.normalization: none for measurement; optional normalization only for preview images
invalid_values: zero as invalid sentinel must be documented per fixture

acceptance.thresholds: To be defined after baseline capture. Do not reuse values from unrelated blur or keying studies.

width_calibration.status: empirical linear model implemented in calibrate_width.py; inverse resolution in resolve_line_width.py
width_calibration.validation: residual max 0.08px on sweep rows, 0.52px on hold-out rows
width_calibration.measured_width_step_px: about 2.0 (depth) to 2.65 (alpha) in the hard class
width_calibration.note: Requested width is quantized to ceil(width/2) core radius; requested and measured widths must not be treated as equal. Targets below the floor or between steps are unreachable. Coefficients are specific to this reference model and fixtures.

metric_caveats.unwanted_line_rate: tolerance is requested_width_px + 2, so small requested widths are judged more strictly; compare within one width setting.
